OurMission.title: Our Mission
OurMission.description: We are here to champion robotics and empower students through hands-on experience, logical thinking, and teamwork. We strive to create an open, shared space where members don’t just refine their skills—they learn how to tackle the world's most complex problems, together.

CoreProjects.title: Core Projects
CoreProjects.description: We layer our technologies, striving for excellence at every level.

web.title: Web Platform
web.subtitle: Full-stack Development
web.desc: A modern portal built on React & Next.js. Beyond a showcase, it represents our commitment to front-end tech and design aesthetics.

mentor.title: Robot Mentor
mentor.subtitle: Beginner Wheeled Robot
mentor.desc: An entry-level wheeled robot designed for our curriculum. Its modular design helps members master sensors, motor drivers, and Arduino logic.

pathfinder.title: Robot Pathfinder
pathfinder.subtitle: Pro Competition Project
pathfinder.desc: A high-performance machine built for precision. Developed independently by our core team to push the limits of speed and control.

ios.title: iOS App
ios.subtitle: Native Application
ios.desc: Built natively with SwiftUI. It integrates club calendars and check-in systems, serving as the core of our digital transformation.

0.title: Hands-on Focus
0.description: We don't just talk. Every member gets to solder circuits, code, and build hardware, turning ideas into reality.

1.title: Team Spirit
1.description: Building robots is a team effort. You'll learn communication, collaboration, and how to tackle challenges together.

2.title: Cross-disciplinary
2.description: We welcome students from all fields—IT, Healthcare, Marketing, and more. Diverse perspectives spark the most creative solutions.

0.title: General Meeting & Orientation
0.description: The first session of our club starts with getting to know each other. We introduce the mission, bylaws, and future plans, guide members through the website's features, and complete interest-based grouping to lay a solid foundation for upcoming hands-on courses.

1.title: Robot Hardware Assembly
1.description: The first large-scale hands-on event. Starting from individual components, members assemble the robot car's structure and connect circuits based on schematics, experiencing the creative process of turning parts into a complete robot.

2.title: Robot Programming
2.description: After hardware assembly, we breathe life into the robot. Starting from Arduino IDE installation, members learn to read sensor values and write logic to make the robot car truly move.

3.title: Robotics Competition
3.description: The club's first internal competition combined with an on-site workshop. Officers explain core algorithms, and members adjust code and familiarize themselves with the track on the spot before robots attempt to navigate the map autonomously.

meta.title: About | Robotics Research Club of CTUST
meta.description: Learn about the CTUST Robotics Research Club — our founding mission, activities, and members. We are dedicated to promoting robotics education and providing students with hands-on learning opportunities.

hero.title: Discover the Endless Possibilities of Robotics
hero.subtitle: Explore, build, and grow alongside a community of like-minded enthusiasts — one step, one creation at a time.

origin.label: Our Story
origin.heading: Sparked by a Shared Passion for Robotics
origin.paragraph1: In the fall of 2025, Shih-Chi, Tai-Ling, and Chang-Lung crossed paths through their shared love of robotics. Seeing fellow students on campus pouring themselves into their own projects, they asked themselves: what if there were a place where everyone could come together — to build, to learn, and to grow? That question is what led them to found the CTUST Robotics Research Club.
origin.paragraph2: The idea quickly turned into action. At the October club fair, the newly formed club made its debut — drawing nearly thirty new members to sign up. The first workshop followed soon after. There were bumps along the way: technical hiccups, curriculum tweaks, and plenty of on-the-fly adjustments. But the three founders believed those rough edges were all part of the process. Each setback helped them find the teaching style and club culture that felt right.
origin.paragraph3: Today, the club is no longer just three people's dream — it's a learning community of dozens of passionate members. We still carry the same founding spirit: that every hands-on session and every moment of shared discovery is what makes this club worth building. We look forward to exploring this journey alongside you — from parts to machine, one step at a time.

culture.label: Club Culture
culture.heading: Feeling the Pulse of Robotics Through Practice
culture.narrative: We believe the real learning journey in robotics doesn't happen in textbooks — it happens the moment you start building. Step into one of our workshops and you'll see it: newcomers focused intently on assembling their first robot, veterans patiently walking a friend through a tricky circuit, everyone learning through trial and discussion. There's no such thing as a bad question here — just people helping each other and always pushing to improve. No matter where you're starting from, if you care about robotics, there's a place for you here.

moments.title: Hands-On Building
moments.description: From parts to assembly — only by building it yourself do you truly feel the joy of creation.

moments.title: Learning Together
moments.description: No bad questions. Just teammates exploring side by side, helping each other grow.

moments.title: Always Improving
moments.description: Listen, reflect, and iterate — finding better ways forward with every step.

philosophy.heading: From Parts to Machine, Together
philosophy.body: Every robot begins with a single part, and every person's growth begins with the willingness to try. We believe the most valuable part of the journey isn't the finished product — it's the warmth of building something alongside others, the shared thinking, and the memories made along the way.
philosophy.invitation: Whether you're just starting out or already deep into the world of robotics, you're welcome here. We look forward to taking each step alongside you — building from parts to machine, and finding our story together.
